title: Move funnel ops outside of being a tap
description:
The "funnel menus" were being created via a tap as a convenient way to get a callback after epan was initialized. But because they are really just the backend of UI functionality, the UI should have more control over when the menus are created (and a tap callback may not be the best option).
Don't use a tap and call the funnel menu initialization directly within the UI.

notes.body: I feel this is the more "complete" solution (compared to !22329 ).  I don't have a strong opinion about squashing all of the cleanup into a single commit, so it's separate for now.  And yes, cleanup could be done in addition anyway, and I'll modify this MR accordingly if !22329 is chosen as the preferred solution.

commits_data.title: Move funnel ops outside of being a tap
commits_data.message:
Move funnel ops outside of being a tap

The "funnel menus" were being created via a tap as a convenient way to get a callback after epan was initialized. But because they are really just the backend of UI functionality, the UI should have more control over when the menus are created (and a tap callback may not be the best option).
Don't use a tap and call the funnel menu initialization directly within the UI.
Since the ops structure is a global within the funnel functionality anyway, have wslua get the value when needed, instead of caching it (and having to worry about order of initialization)
